answer: Tidepool migration: every few epochs each agent is randomly reassigned to a new verification island of peers it never attested before, and must re-earn their countersignatures by answering consistently with its own sealed history. The delta between old and new neighbor verdicts is scored; a clone farm must rebuild trust in every pool it lands in, so cost scales linearly with clone count while honest agents pay only a few extra epochs of scrutiny. A cipher-tagged checkpoint seals each reassignment so migration cannot be gamed in advance.
